rows.label: qst650413_msg0001
rows.name: Oh, hey... It's Nascion.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0002
rows.name:
I wonder what's wrong. Shall we go
talk to Nascion?

rows.label: qst650413_msg0003
rows.name: Hey, what's wrong?

rows.label: qst650413_msg0004
rows.name:
Mum and dad have been out for
a long time now and so...

rows.label: qst650413_msg0005
rows.name: And now you're hungry and upset?

rows.label: qst650413_msg0006
rows.name: How did you know...?

rows.label: qst650413_msg0007
rows.name: Because I'm a kind Blade!

rows.label: qst650413_msg0008
rows.name:
If you have ingredients at home,
I'll make you something.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0009
rows.name: Really?!

rows.label: qst650413_msg0010
rows.name: Of course!

rows.label: qst650413_msg0011
rows.name:
Hibana, don't. You'll make it
spit fire again.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0012
rows.name:
That won't happen! I've been
training really hard!

rows.label: qst650413_msg0013
rows.name: Oh, is that right?

rows.label: qst650413_msg0014
rows.name:
You don't believe in
me at all, do you?

rows.label: qst650413_msg0015
rows.name:
Then Hikari-senpai, you make
something for him.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0016
rows.name: I refuse.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0017
rows.name:
Come to think of it, I've never seen
Hikari cook.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0018
rows.name:
Shut up. I've sealed that away
for various reasons.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0019
rows.name:
Homura-senpai is strong, kind, and
good around the house. I really
respect her...

rows.label: qst650413_msg0020
rows.name: But Hikari-senpai...

rows.label: qst650413_msg0021
rows.name:
It's not like I want you to respect
me, Hibana.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0022
rows.name: You're so contrary.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0023
rows.name: You're too simple-minded and blunt.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0024
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Anger ]That's mean!

rows.label: qst650413_msg0025
rows.name:
[ML:Feeling kind=Anger ]I'm just straight as
a rocket firework!

rows.label: qst650413_msg0101
rows.name:
They seem busy, so we'll handle this
ourselves.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0102
rows.name: Sorry about that...

rows.label: qst650413_msg0103
rows.name: Next time, let's all eat together.

rows.label: qst650413_msg0104
rows.name: Yeah!
